items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: Right after coming out of the service, I played with Paul Barbera.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, you played with Paul Barbera? Right after coming out of the service, I played with Paul Barbera. Yeah, I never heard you in those days, you see.
Yeah. I never, didn't live here. Uh-huh. Well, when did you get out of the service, about? 46th.
